Exam authority: part A states issuer, handbook revision and test structure; question count, passing score and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- NC-INS-A-EXAM — knowledge-test question count, passing score and time limit not printed in the handbook (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NC-INS-D-RENEW — renewal timing worded as six months before birthday on one page and 180 days before expiration on another (owner HallucinationAuditor).
- NC-INS-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- NC-INS-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
